SHIPPED: Whisnap v1.0.7 tagged and released (tag: v1.0.7, 6 commits over v1.0.6)
SIGNIFICANCE: Closes overlay pill, tray menu, theme strip, hide dock icon, and FN hotkey swapping features
CHANGELOG:
- Overlay pill: click-to-record with native hover/click detection; redesigned idle pill with hover keybind hint
- Tray menu: improved structure with Send Feedback action
- Settings: removed theme switching (hardcoded dark mode); added hide dock icon toggle for menu-bar-only mode
- Hotkeys: all FN-based shortcuts are now fully swappable
ENABLES: Clean slate for next feature batch
